results.title: The VPS Caddy block routes the editor's public host as designed: editor pages, the plugin, and /health to the API; /api/* and /health/* refused; everything else to DocumentServer
evidence: /health reaches the API: /health → 200 application/json, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin: true
/api/status is refused: /api/status → 403 application/json: true
/api/documents/open is refused: /api/documents/open → 403 application/json: true
/health/converter is refused: /health/converter → 404 : true
/health/converter-sample.docx is refused: /health/converter-sample.docx → 404 : true
the bridge plugin comes from the API: /plugins/udoc-bridge/config.json → 200 application/json, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin: true
an editor page goes to the API with its no-referrer policy intact (a bad token gets its expired page): /editor/not-a-token → 410 text/html, Referrer-Policy no-referrer: true
DocumentServer's connection statistics stay inside its container (F7): /info/info.json → 403 text/html: true
DocumentServer's health check comes from DocumentServer: /healthcheck → 200 text/plain: true
DocumentServer's JS API comes from DocumentServer: /web-apps/apps/api/documents/api.js → 200 application/javascript: true
